# Adil Rahman — Full-Stack, Flutter & Shopify Engineer

> Full-stack software engineer and mobile app developer based in Kerala, India. Specializes in cross-platform mobile apps (Flutter), scalable cloud web applications (Next.js 15, React 19, Supabase, Cloudflare Workers), and bespoke e-commerce engineering (Shopify Liquid).

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Flutter Mobile & Web Development:** 60 FPS cross-platform apps for iOS, Android, and PWAs. Clean Riverpod/Provider state architecture, local SQLite/Hive caching, background audio processing, on-device TensorFlow Lite models. Typical MVP turnaround: 2–4 weeks.
- **Custom Shopify Liquid Engineering:** Bespoke theme development, custom section architecture, conversion rate optimization, and API webhooks. Typical turnaround: 1–2 weeks.
- **Next.js & Cloud Edge Architecture:** Multi-tenant B2B SaaS platforms, Supabase PostgreSQL, edge proxy routing, and WhatsApp/Google Sheets automation. Typical turnaround: 2–4 weeks.

## Verified Portfolio & Case Studies
- [AR Membership Manager](https://adilrahman.cc/saas/membership-saas): Multi-tenant B2B gym management SaaS with automated WhatsApp reminders.
- [Edu Amicus Cloud Migration](https://adilrahman.cc/saas/edu-amicus-deployment): SQLite-to-Supabase migration and edge-proxied deployment on Railway & Cloudflare.
- [ZMR Music](https://adilrahman.cc/saas/zmr): YouTube Music client in Flutter with background isolates and lockscreen playback.
- [ViewPick](https://adilrahman.cc/saas/viewpick): Swipe-based movie discovery PWA built with Flutter Web and TMDB.
- [Fileo](https://adilrahman.cc/project/niche-sites/fileo): 100% in-browser, privacy-first file conversion platform built with Astro 5 and WebAssembly (Live: https://fileo.cc).
- [Free ATS Resume Builder](https://adilrahman.cc/tools/resume-builder): Browser-based ATS resume builder with dual PDF export engines.
